title: Terentianus Maurus, De litteris, De syllabis, De metris — verse treatise on letters, syllables and metres; Теренциан Мавр. Proposed unit: preface + De litteris
author: Terentianus Maurus
genre: Didactic poem on grammar and metre
edition: Keil, Grammatici Latini VI (1874, public domain); Cignolo, Olms 2002 (copyright)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Теренциан Мавр' lists only Keil's edition; no Russian translation found
en_evidence: None found; a UNESP thesis notes only Italian (2) and French (1) translations
other_translations: Italian ×2, French ×1; complete Portuguese (I. M. P. de Jesus, UNESP 2020)
value: Unique poem that shows each metre in that metre. Key evidence for Latin pronunciation and metrics, and attractive to literary readers as well as linguists
ai_feasibility: medium — needs prose plus metrical notes; phonetic descriptions require a linguist's check
